Inside the guardrails the builder cannot do more. This review cannot pass the finding while it is open; it goes to the owner, not back to the builder.

Architecture concern on the current scoping (for the owner's ruling): it ties two separate controls together. Token partitions (R1 to R3) and the completeness precondition (R4) answer different failure modes (4 and 5 in the filing), yet configuring partitions now silently switches on a change to the review flow, and a project that wants completeness but no partitions cannot have it. If the owner amends R4 rather than authorizing the test updates, a cleaner shape is an explicit switch of its own (for example efficiency.completeness_gate, or a key next to the checks gate config) that the factory anvil.yaml turns on. The runner should not infer it from budget keys. Decision 0014 records the coupling and its trade off honestly (status proposed), which is right, but the decision needs the owner's acceptance before the coupling is treated as settled.

RESOLVED (reviewer-tests R4(a)/S4): the missing or empty builder report case is now pinned. test_s4_missing_builder_report_dispatches_zero_reviewers requires a gap naming runs/wo-sbc/builder.output.md. The new test_s4_missing_report_alone_blocks_review_when_checks_pass and test_s4_completeness_gaps_names_a_missing_or_empty_report isolate the report gap on an otherwise complete attempt. The builder reports the mutation (if not _nonempty_file(report) -> if False) now fails 5 CompletenessGate tests. _nonempty_file (anvil/runner.py:1176) now applies the same whitespace-is-empty rule as gates.validate_builder_report, so the two places agree on what empty means without the precondition repeating literal validation (S9 holds).

Boundaries fit the existing structure: configuration parsing and validation stay in anvil/config.py (station_budget_settings, validate_station_budgets, fail closed with the pipeline and excess named). Measured consumption from usage artifacts sits in anvil/telemetry.py (precall_decision). Orchestration (pre-call check, completeness_gaps, budget outcomes, cost per station) sits in anvil/runner.py. The in-flight kill sits in tools/claude_station.py and follows the station-timeout kill-and-record shape. completeness_gaps is a pure, read-only function over artifacts and verdicts already decided. It runs no command and leaves gates.py unchanged, as the reconciliation requires.

Single exit path respected: refusals and in-flight ceiling kills end the run through the wo-gh-41 path (exit_status budget_exceeded, termination_reason). No second termination mechanism was added. The efficiency.station_budgets key is kept apart from the frozen top-level station_budgets (astra-consumption packet cap), and docs/EXECUTION.md names both.
